flagged.title: The Origins of the Weimar Republic 1918–19
flagged.reason: The video teaches the incorrect dates for both the Turnip Winter (stated as 1917–18 instead of 1916–17) and the Kiel Mutiny (stated as beginning on 29 October at Kiel with 1,000 arrests instead of 3 November at Kiel following initial unrest at Wilhelmshaven), which would cost students marks on GCSE chronology and factual recall.

mark_affecting.quote: what became known as the Turnip Winter of 1917 to 1918
On the 29th of October, naval commanders ordered the German fleet to sail out of Kiel ... arresting around a thousand of these protesting sailors

flagged.title: Stresemann & the Golden Age 1924–29
flagged.reason: The video prominently states and displays the loan figure as '$800 million' instead of 800 million marks (approx. $200 million), teaching an incorrect figure tested in lesson assessments and mark schemes.

mark_affecting.quote: $800M ... specifically 800 million dollars. Stresemann looked right across the Atlantic to the United States for help, and this number represents the initial loan from American banks under the 1924 Dawes Plan.
